title: Senior Backend Engineer
requirements: Candidates should bring at least five years of backend engineering experience, with deep, hands-on proficiency in Rust for building high-throughput, low-latency services. Strong command of PostgreSQL is required, including schema design, query optimization, and experience operating it at scale in a transactional environment. The role calls for practical experience designing and maintaining gRPC service contracts across a distributed microservice topology, along with proven Kubernetes experience for deploying and operating containerized workloads in production. Familiarity with asynchronous Rust, particularly the Tokio runtime, is essential, as the majority of our transaction-processing services are built on it. Prior experience in payments, banking, or another regulated financial services environment is strongly preferred, as is comfort working within strict correctness and auditability constraints.
responsibilities: You will design, build, and operate core services within our payment settlement platform, working primarily in Rust against PostgreSQL-backed data stores. You will define and evolve gRPC APIs consumed by adjacent teams, ensuring backward compatibility and clear contracts as the service mesh grows. Day to day work includes profiling and tuning asynchronous Tokio-based services under real transaction load, diagnosing latency regressions, and shipping fixes to production via our Kubernetes-based deployment pipeline. You will participate in architecture reviews for new payment flows, collaborate with the risk and compliance teams on data-handling requirements, and mentor engineers earlier in their careers on our backend conventions and Rust idioms.
construction_rationale: Grade 3: exact title match, full core stack (Rust, PostgreSQL, gRPC, Kubernetes, Tokio), senior level, fintech/payments domain — formal register.
